comments.author: Chrius
comments.body_html: Hi, I’m really enjoying the mod, but I have a suggestion. I don’t remember which mod (I think it may have been Better Keys NG), but they had the same issue as this, where every time there was an update it was necessary to change the settings again. The way they fixed it was by having a second config file (configuser.jsonc) on the same folder as the default config, and if that file exists, the mod loads the settings from there, if it doesn’t, it loads the default config file. It would be nice to have something like this here, so that every time there’s an update we could just extract the files and not have to worry about losing settings. It’s not really the end of the world if that’s not possible, but it would be cool. Thank you.
